items.title: Live: Geelong oil refinery fire 'very confronting', CEO says as blaze rages out of control
items.description: Authorities are working to douse an out-of-control blaze engulfing the Geelong Viva Enery oil refinery, one of two major refineries in the country. Follow live.

items.title: Refinery blaze may impact Australia's petrol production 'for some time'
items.description: Energy Minister Chris Bowen says the fire in Geelong appears to be an accident at this stage and there are no suspicious circumstances.

items.title: Albanese government's frustration rises as Australians pay price for war
items.description: Fuel prices and inflation aren't the only metrics climbing as the Strait of Hormuz remains shut. The Albanese government's level of frustration is rising just as fast.

items.title: Live: Iranian-flagged ship tries to evade US blockade as Pakistan mediators arrive in Tehran
items.description: The US president says a deal with Iran is "preferable" and people should expect an "amazing two days" ahead. Follow live.

items.title: Talk of ceasefire in Lebanon as strait blockade continues: What to know today on Iran
items.description: Israeli forces are expected to "overwhelm" parts of southern Lebanon and yet a ceasefire may still be only a matter of days away.

items.title: Creators of fuel dashboard quoted by News Corp have links to Liberals
items.description: An ABC NEWS Verify investigation raises questions about popular independent fuel security dashboards that have emerged online, including one whose creators are linked to the Liberal Party.

items.title: Why Australia turned to tiny nation to secure critical fertiliser supplies
items.description: The Middle East conflict has disrupted the flow of Australia's imports of the fertiliser urea. Facing the potential threat of reduced crop yields, Anthony Albanese looked to Australia's neighbours.

items.title: Defence spending to climb by $53 billion as 'international norms' erode
items.description: Australia's defence spending will climb by $53 billion over the next decade amid what the federal government says are "intensifying" global risks.

items.title: Ukraine looking to 'capitalise' on new momentum against Russia
items.description: Western officials and analysts say Ukrainian forces have disrupted Russia's planned spring offensive and managed to retake territory.

items.title: Live: Markets set to open flat with fuel crisis likely to worsen
items.description: The fuel crisis is set to worsen after a massive fire at one of Australia's two oil refineries. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Supermarkets stalling over pressure to lift milk prices
items.description: Supermarket milk price rises linked to the war in Iran are predicted in the coming months as hundreds of dairy farmers battling increasing costs receive more for their product.

items.title: Kerr scores landmark goal as Matildas win FIFA Series
items.description: Sam Kerr's 75th international goal has helped the Matildas to a surprisingly tough, controversial 2-0 victory over Kenya in the FIFA Series final.

items.title: WA Police won't remove racist comments on its social media posts
items.description: Racist comments are being published on WA Police social media posts with little moderation, but the force says it is not prepared to switch off comments.

items.title: Gina Rinehart 'won' the legal battle for Hope Downs, commentator says
items.description: Gina Rinehart and her company, Hancock Prospecting, are the "clear winners" of what prominent Perth industry commentator Tim Treadgold said was the "big daddy" of legal battles.

items.title: Back Roads: How this tiny town welcomed a 70-piece orchestra
items.description: The Sydney Youth Orchestras travelled to this tiny town to help inspire the local kids, but when they left, they were the ones who felt changed.

items.title: Rebel Wilson's directorial debut hits Aus cinemas amid legal dispute
items.description: Plus a powerful look Palestinian life through multiple generations and a buzzy Japanese video game adaptation makes it to Australian shores.

items.title: Quiz: Can you tell the difference between The Pitt and E.R.?
items.description: Ahead of The Pitt season finale dropping this week, can you pick the difference between it and its hospital drama ancestor E.R.?

items.title: Global tour operator Intrepid invests millions in outback tourism
items.description: Australian-based global tour operator Intrepid has announced a multi-million-dollar investment in Central Australia's Ooraminna Homestead, 30 kilometres south of Alice Springs.

items.title: WA wine industry warns of impact of Containers for Change expansion
items.description: A newly formed West Australian wine group warns that bottles of wine produced in the state could increase by $1.25 if the expansion of the Containers for Change scheme goes ahead.

items.title: Proposal to block non-citizens from first homebuyer scheme slammed
items.description: Multicultural groups are concerned Angus Taylor's proposal to prevent permanent residents from accessing the Australian Government 5% Deposit Scheme could deter skilled migrants from coming to Australia.

items.title: Woman suffers brain injury after 'toxic dose' of wrong drug
items.description: A 36-year-old woman who says she suffered a "hypoxic brain injury" when she was given a "toxic dose" of the wrong drug during routine surgery at Palmerston Regional Hospital is suing the Northern Territory government for negligence.

items.title: Arrest warrant issued in legal battle for $27k in unpaid long service leave
items.description: It's now been over three years since two women left their jobs at a small business. Two courts later, they want their combined $27,000 in long service leave paid out to them, and say they won't give up until they get it.

items.title: 'Canary in coal mine' warning as marine pest found in new area
items.description: The discovery on Tasmania's west coast has scientists and fishers alike fearing the spread of a destructive species to another previously untouched part of the state's marine environment.

items.title: A lucky chat, then a lifeline for men with prostate cancer
items.description: Michael Platts panicked when he was diagnosed with prostate cancer. Now he wants to help others break through the stigma and silence surrounding the condition.

items.title: Manhunt underway after prisoner mistakenly released from jail
items.description: The ABC understands Kyle Quayle was wrongfully released from Clarence Correctional Centre on Tuesday and is believed to be in the Newcastle area.
